description: Defines classes and structures related to MTP (Media Transfer Protocol) properties, including MtpProperty and MtpPropertyValue, with methods for reading, writing, and managing property data.

classes.name: MtpProperty
classes.description: Represents an MTP property with attributes like code, type, default/current values, and methods to manipulate these properties.

classes.name: MtpPropertyValue
classes.description: A union-based structure to hold different types of property values, including a string in UTF8 format.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads property data from an MtpDataPacket.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes property data to an MtpDataPacket.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value from a UTF8 string.

methods.name: setCurrentValue
methods.description: Sets the current value from a UTF8 string.

methods.name: setFormRange
methods.description: Defines a range form with min, max, and step.

methods.name: setFormEnum
methods.description: Defines an enum form with specific values.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints a property value into a buffer.

methods.name: isDeviceProperty
methods.description: Checks if the property code indicates a device property.

methods.name: readValue
methods.description: Reads a property value from a data packet.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a property value to a data packet.

methods.name: readArrayValues
methods.description: Reads an array of property values from a data packet.

methods.name: writeArrayValues
methods.description: Writes an array of property values to a data packet.
